project_type: Next.js 16.4.3 App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Auth.js
build_system: Next.js with npm, includes Turbopack for dev
verification_instructions: Run 'npm run dev' to start the dev server, verify each page visually for Apple design compliance, check responsive behavior on mobile/desktop, verify all interactive states (hover, focus, active), ensure no console errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that need to be committed
environment_constraints: Dev server runs on default Next.js port (3000). MongoDB connection required. Windows environment with bash shell.
contribution_requirements: Follow AGENTS.md guidelines - read Next.js docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for breaking changes. Never hard-code prices or settings. All money values in integer rupees. Use server actions for mutations. Follow Apple design system specs exactly.
key_patterns: shadcn/ui components with Radix UI primitives, Tailwind utility classes with custom Apple color tokens, Lucide icons at 20px with strokeWidth=2, server/client component separation, form handling with react-hook-form + zod, use cn() utility for className merging
directory_structure: app/ contains pages and API routes using Next.js App Router. components/ has ui/ (primitives), layout/ (Sidebar, TopBar, BottomNav), and feature-specific folders. lib/ contains database models, services (business logic), validators, and utilities. Public assets in public/.
